summary: Hesai Group filed a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited financial results for Q2 2026. The press release details quarterly net revenues of RMB860.8 million, lidar shipments of 628,275 units, and net income of RMB70.6 million. Management highlights expansion into robotics and physical AI infrastructure, with new orders from humanoid robotics companies. This is a routine earnings announcement for a foreign private issuer. No special-situation transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is disclosed. The filing is purely operational and financial in nature, with no M&A, restructuring, or other special event. The appropriate classification is None, as it does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category.
